## How to obtain

Break a tree trunk with your hands, or use an axe for faster chopping and upward tree felling.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.

## Furnace fuel

One item supplies **15 seconds** of burning fuel. Use it in a [Furnace](Item-furnace.md) for smelting or cooking.
